publishDialog.title: Publish Course
publishDialog.description: This will create a new published version of the course. Members currently enrolled will remain on their existing version.
publishDialog.supersedeDescription: If checked, users enrolled in previous versions will be automatically moved to this new version. Their progress might be lost if scenes were removed or changed significantly.
publishDialog.gateDialogDescription: Publishing a course is part of a subscription. Everything you have built stays open to edit and to preview.
publishDialog.gateDescription: Subscribe to publish this course and enroll learners. Authoring and preview are unaffected. Nothing you have built is locked away.
publishDialog.gateLapsedDescription: Courses can no longer be published. Reactivate the subscription to publish and enroll again; authoring and preview stay open.
